title: Henri Coanda's patent and Project Y at Wright-Patterson

plain: A Romanian scientist named Henri Coanda held a patent from 1936 on a flying design, and Michels says Coanda was in Vichy France, the part of France governed in step with the Nazis, where he was forced to work for them. Afterwards, Michels says, Coanda was taken to Wright-Patterson, a US Air Force base in Ohio, to work on Project Y, which Michels describes as an extension of the Avro car project, an effort to make flying saucers actually fly. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a sign that saucer-shaped craft were being built in secret.
